# nynjworldcup

> nynjworldcup helps fans find 2026 FIFA World Cup watch parties across the
> New York City and New Jersey metro area, organized by country and diaspora
> neighborhood.

nynjworldcup is a free app for the 2026 FIFA World Cup (June 11 – July 19,
2026). It maps watch parties at diaspora bars and venues across NYC and NJ
for all 48 participating nations — for example, Brazil supporters in Astoria,
Queens or Portugal supporters in the Ironbound, Newark. Fans follow their
teams, see every match in the schedule, find a bar near them, and save a
matchday plan.

It is currently a beta web app; a native iOS app is in App Store review.

## Key facts
- Focus: 2026 FIFA World Cup watch parties in the NYC + NJ metro area
- Coverage: all 48 nations in the 2026 World Cup
- Organized by: country and diaspora neighborhood (e.g. Astoria, the Ironbound, Jackson Heights)
- Platform: beta web app now; native iOS app coming soon to the App Store
- Price: free
